title: PIRIN EXTREME 38K - race day
terrain: 38.1km, 3440m D+ (GPX). Km 0-13: climb 923->2908m (Vihren). Km 13-28: traverse above 2000m, 9.7km above 2500m. Km 28-38: one 1250m descent to Bansko

steps.target: Z2, opening 1900m climb, hike it, 130-145 bpm
Z2-Z3 high traverse, effort not pace, 140-155 bpm
Z2 final 1250m descent, controlled, short stride, 130-150 bpm

coachNotes:
THE RACE IN THREE PARTS. 1) Opening 1900m climb from the gun, km 0-13: hike it, strictly conversational, 130-145 bpm, let people pass. 2) High traverse, km 13-28 with 9.7km above 2500m: run on effort and HR, 140-155 bpm, pace means nothing that high. 3) Final 1250m descent to Bansko on 7h legs, the single ITB test of the day: poles, short stride, brake with cadence not quads, 165-170 spm.
FUEL: 80 g/h from minute one. 1 Enervit Isocarb C2:1 Pro sachet per 500ml bottle per hour plus 1 Carbo Gel C2:1 Pro every second hour, roughly 8 sachets and 4 gels over 7h45. Carry plain water separately for the traverse, 150-250ml with every gel. Nothing new on the day, this exact system is rehearsed 30 Aug and 5 Sep.
ESTIMATE: 7h45 moving, from your Erve pace reference plus an altitude penalty.
LOGISTICS: registration and mandatory medical check Friday 13:00-20:00 in Bansko.
